channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Herzog’s Rosh Hashanah message: ‘We are here, we are strong’
item.description: President Isaac Herzog marks Rosh Hashanah with a message of Jewish pride, action, and unity, urging Jews in Israel and worldwide to listen to one another.

item.title: IDF alerts northern residents of explosions that will be heard from Lebanon later
item.description: IDF alerts northern residents of explosions that will be heard from Lebanon later

item.title: Netanyahu: Iran is trying to rearm, I won't let them have nuclear weapons
item.description: Speaking at the Western Wall ahead of Rosh Hashanah, Netanyahu pledges Iran will not obtain nuclear weapons as long as he remains Prime Minister.

item.title: IDF confirms: Terrorist who murdered six Jews in Judea and Samaria eliminated
item.description: Farah Hamed, freed to Gaza in the 2011 Shalit deal, was linked to deadly attacks in Binyamin and later recruited Hamas terrorists for attacks in Judea and Samaria.

item.title: “Complete lie:" Ben Gvir sues Gadi Eisenkot for NIS 100,000
item.description: Otzma Yehudit chairman demands compensation from Eisenkot over claims made on a podcast that Ben Gvir spreads violent messages on social media.

item.title: Change in tone: Rabbi Yitzhak Yosef launches attack on Eisenkot
item.description: Rabbi Yitzhak Yosef warns against an Eisenkot-led government, just two months after praising the Yashar chairman and saying Shas could support him for PM.

item.title: The Jewish Year art collection: Inner Lights
item.description: An artistic interpretation of the annual Jewish Holidays.

item.title: Following week-long pursuit: IDF apprehends terrorist planning imminent shooting attack
item.description:
Earlier today (Thursday), IDF soldiers, in conjunction with the Shin Bet, apprehended the terrorist Ismail Ankaio in the Beitunia area, along with an additional wanted individual.
Ankaio was planning to carry out an imminent shooting attack and was apprehended following a week-long pursuit of him.

item.title: Child collapses at mall, life saved by defibrillator
item.description: A child lost consciousness at a shopping center. A medic who arrived within two minutes treated him with two electric shocks, restoring his heartbeat.

item.title: US forces redirected 96 commercial vessels attempting to reach Iran
item.description: US Central Command says that as of Thursday, US forces have redirected 96 commercial vessels to ensure total compliance with the blockade of Iran. More than 50 vessels supporting humanitarian aid have been allowed to pass.

item.title: From coded emojis to old lies: 9/11 antisemitism persists online
item.description: CyberWell identifies scores of posts falsely blaming Jews and Israel for the 9/11 attacks, warning that decades-old conspiracies continue to spread online.

item.title: Looking above the parties
item.description: Just before Rosh Hashanah and with elections looming ahead, let us contemplate the great miracles that the Jewish people have undergone.

item.title: Maj. Gen. Bluth to Yesha leaders: Partnership is what enables terrorism prevention
item.description: Central Command chief criticizes attempts to create divisions between settlement leaders and forces on the ground, stressing that cooperation is key to maintaining governance.

item.title: Japan lowers travel warning for Israel
item.description: The Japanese government announced that it has lowered its travel warning for Israel. The move is expected to lead to renewed visits by Japanese delegations and businesspeople and to deepen cooperation between the two countries.

item.title: Despite being past 67' lines: UK says Jews can visit Western Wall
item.description: British government says Israelis at the Western Wall and Jewish Quarter are not unlawfully present, clarifying its stance after adopting the ICJ position.

item.title: Eisenkot’s Yashar Party signs surplus-vote deal with Democrats
item.description: Eisenkot’s Yashar Party will sign a surplus-vote agreement with the Democrats after Liberman’s Yisrael Beytenu struck a deal with Bennett and Lapid.

item.title: New record: Nearly 69,000 Jews ascended the Temple Mount over last year
item.description: The number of Jewish visitors to the Temple Mount increased significantly this year, despite the site being closed to Jews for 134 days due to security concerns, Muslim holidays and Shabbat.

item.title: IAEA confirms signs of activity at Iran’s Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site
item.description: IAEA chief Rafael Grossi says remote imagery shows movement at Iran’s fortified Pickaxe Mountain site, but inspectors still do not know what is underway.

item.title: ‘I will sit in prison’: Israeli refuses to comply with IDF order
item.description: Court orders Tal Yinon Derdik held until end of proceedings after alleged violations of an administrative order issued by Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth.

item.title: IDF eliminates Hamas Nukhba terrorist who killed Nahal commander
item.description: IDF eliminates Hamas Nukhba terrorist Ismail Kandil, who took part in killing Col. Yonatan Steinberg and recently advanced attacks on Israelis.

item.title: Sylvan Adams & Ron Dermer: 'Israel must use its power to oppose war against Jews'
item.description: At Los Angeles stop of Dermer’s Unite. Lead. Fight. tour, Adams and Dermer call for Israel to deploy its intelligence, cyber and strategic capabilities against antisemitism worldwide.

item.title: More Jews need to train in Michael Rapaport’s style of Jew Fu
item.description: Antisemitism is not a misunderstanding to be corrected. It is a functioning social technology that organizes identity, supplies a scapegoat and simplifies the moral universe for people who want it simplified. Rappaport knows how to deal with it. Opinion.

item.title: Britain’s Jewish foreign secretary knows the Jewish story
item.description: Ed Miliband invoked his family’s refuge in Israel before announcing a policy that economically isolates Jewish communities in the land where Jewish history began.

item.title: Friedman meets settler filmed by Huckabee: ‘This one won’t work’
item.description: David Friedman meets Amishav Melet, the security patrol driver filmed by Mike Huckabee, and pushes back against claims of ‘settler violence.’

item.title: The Chief Rabbi’s Rosh Hashanah Message 5787
item.description: Stand tall as Jews. Be proud of who you are, even when it is difficult.

item.title: Otzma Yehudit: “Netanyahu has already chosen Eisenkot"
item.description: Ben Gvir’s party claims Likud is working to weaken Otzma Yehudit in order to pave the way for a unity government with Gadi Eisenkot.

item.title: Algeria cuts ties with UAE
item.description:
Algeria announced that it was severing relations with the United Arab Emirates, saying it had “exhausted all means of preserving bilateral relations between the two countries."
The announcement provided no further details about the move.

item.title: Houthis seize strategic Red Sea city, threaten key shipping route
item.description: Capture of Al-Mokha puts Houthi forces closer to the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, raising fears of a new chokehold on global trade and energy routes.

item.title: ‘It’s a real threat’: Anti-Israel groups hunt IDF soldiers abroad
item.description: Shurat HaDin’s Nitsana Darshan-Leitner warns of an escalating campaign to pursue IDF soldiers abroad and explains how a new app aims to protect them.

item.title: Katz to Iran: Attack Israel, face a blow unlike any before
item.description: Defense Minister sends New Year wishes to Iran's Jews, warns Tehran any attack on Israel will trigger devastating response.
